Add a sensitivity band to a top_group_plot()

add_sensitivity_ribbon.Rd

Adds the quantile band of the sensitivity draws for one fit underneath a plot made with top_group_plot(), on the same frequency scale and time axis.

Usage

add_sensitivity_ribbon(
  p,
  sens,
  key,
  vax_start,
  qtile = 0.95,
  fill = "#1B9E77",
  alpha = 0.25
)

Arguments

p

A plot from top_group_plot().

sens

Result of run_sensitivity().

key

Id (loss column in sens) of the fit to show the band for.

vax_start

The vax_start used in p.

qtile

Quantile range of the band.

fill, alpha

Fill colour and transparency of the band.

Value

The plot with the band underneath all other layers.
